title: Malawi's Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0)
organization: Government of Malawi, Environmental Affairs Department
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and disaster information and adaptation targets reported in 2026

title: Climate-Informed Economic Development Key to Malawi's Future Growth and Resilience
